draft.emotion: safe and sheltered, looking up at the protection above your head
notes: Covers both 'roof' (the outside top, often flat and used as a terrace in India) and 'ceiling' (the inside top surface of a room).
Takes the postposition 'पर' (छत पर — on the roof / on the ceiling). Plural: छतें.
